Estimates the DGP parameters used in the placebo studies of the Sequential Synthetic DiD paper.

estimate_dgp.Rd

Estimates the DGP parameters used in the placebo studies of the Sequential Synthetic DiD paper.

Usage

estimate_dgp(Y, assignment_vector, rank, pi_singular_vec, never_treat)

Arguments

Y

: Dataframe. It is a dataframe of outcomes.

assignment_vector

: Binary/boolen vector. It is a Nx1 vector of treatment assignments.

rank

: Integer. The rank of the estimated signal component L.

Value

A list with the following elements:

  • F: Numeric matrix. The FE of the

  • M: Numeric matrix. The interactive FE of the

  • Sigma: Numeric matrix. The noise covariance matrix.

  • sigma_2: Numeric. The noise variance: the number which is located on the main diagonal of the covariance matrix.

  • pi: Numeric vector.

  • ar_coef: Numeric vector. AR(2) model coefficients for the covariance matrix Sigma. and an element ar_coef with the AR(2) model coefficients underlying the covariance Sigma

  • rownames: Character vector. The row names of Y matrix.

  • colnames: Character vector. The column names Y matrix.
